comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus safely assemble a grinding-wheel stack on a spindle.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-key unlocking, collar tuning, and relocking versus ordered flange/blotter/wheel insertion, spindle alignment, and nut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe dynamic stops with no setting drift versus correct stack order and alignment, seated nut, released hands, and no damaged wheel or over-tightening.
comparison.reason: Generic tightening does not establish overlap; assembly sequencing and dynamic commissioning test different abilities. Candidate rebound/overload/drift thresholds remain unspecified.
